propositions: Approved documentation, metadata, and provenance recommendations from surveys F21–F49 must be implemented across eight child story executions.
Seven repository children must each complete merges to main through Gerrit with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 labels and no unresolved comments.
F21 requires explicit Jira project selection with no default or fallback; F28A records GitHub Actions active and GitHub Issues disabled.
Historical ADR decisions must be preserved while correcting inaccurate cross-references and operational examples without adding mechanical prose or enforcement.
Each child story owns its file set in parallel worktrees, with pedagogish-certain-butterfly as sole pyproject.toml owner; F47 research story must record conclusions without repository modifications.
